test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: Which Indian state was the highest contributor to the All India Nominal GDP in the financial year 2018-19?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points**__

__
 
• **Maharashtra** has the **highest GSDP** in the middle of **33 Indian states and Union Territories.**
 
• According to the Financial Year 2018-19, Maharashtra provides **13.88% of India's GDP at current prices**, followed by** Tamil Nadu (8.59%**) and the most populous state, Uttar Pradesh (8.35%).
 
• At present prices, **Maharashtra's gross state domestic product **was approximately **Rs. 31.98 trillion (US$ 430.62 billion) in 2021–22.**
 
• The Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) of Maharashtra for 2022–23 is estimated to be **Rs 35.81 lakh crore.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​At present prices, **Karnataka's gross state domestic product (GSDP)** is estimated to be **Rs. 18.85 trillion (US$ 243.56 billion) in years 2022–23. **
 
• The **Gross State Domestic Product (GSDP) of Gujarat** for 2022-23 is estimated to be** Rs 22,03,062 crore.**
 
• The economy of **Kerala is the 9th biggest in India,** with an early gross state product (GSP) of **₹9.78 lakh crore (US$131.98 billion) in 2020–2021. **
